description: Use this when the user wants Tenda to remember their business for searches, fit and readiness checks and drafting. Fill in only company facts the user has told you, leaving out anything unsure and any personal details, and show the user what you'll save so they can confirm or correct it first. Saves to their team's workspace and fills in more from Companies House (SAM.gov for a US company) and contracts the company has won. Needs a Tenda account. Not for personal profiles or CVs. Example: {"summary":"Office and school cleaning in Greater Manchester","company_number":"08123456"}

business_size.description: The company's size, e.g. "small" for under 50 staff. Use "vcse" for charities and social enterprises.

buyer_types.description: Kinds of public buyer the company has worked for, e.g. ["local_authority", "education"].

certifications.description: Certifications and accreditations it holds, e.g. ["iso_9001", "cyber_essentials", "chas"]. Add an expiry as "cyber_essentials:2026-11-30".

company_name.description: The company's name, e.g. "Northbridge Services Ltd".

company_number.description: The Companies House number, e.g. "08123456" or "SC123456", or for a US company its SAM.gov Unique Entity ID (UEI), e.g. "JX4M7Q2LK9C1". Tenda looks the company up and finds the public contracts it has won.

employers_liability_gbp.description: Employer's liability cover in the company's home currency, e.g. 10000000.

largest_contract_gbp.description: The largest contract, a year, the company would take on, in its home currency.

nationwide.description: True when the company works anywhere in its country.

professional_indemnity_gbp.description: Professional indemnity cover in the company's home currency.

public_liability_gbp.description: Public liability (in Canada, commercial general liability) cover in the company's home currency, e.g. 5000000.

regions.description: Where the company works, e.g. ["North West", "Yorkshire and the Humber"] or ["Ontario", "Quebec"].

items.description: Where the work or delivery happens: a UK nation or English region, e.g. "North West" for Manchester or Liverpool; a Canadian province or territory, e.g. "Ontario" for Toronto; a US state, e.g. "Virginia"; a German Land by its German name, e.g. "Bayern" for Munich; a French region, e.g. "Île-de-France" for Paris; or another EU member state, e.g. "Poland". Omit for nationwide contracts or when the user names no place.

staff.description: How many people work for the company.

summary.description: What the company does, who for and where, in a few sentences, e.g. "Commercial and school cleaning across Greater Manchester, 40 staff, mostly council and academy trust contracts."

turnover_gbp.description: Annual turnover in the company's home currency (pounds for a UK company, Canadian dollars for a Canadian one), e.g. 2400000.

workspace.description: The Tenda workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".
